prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity NPC eye-animation atlas in native pixel-art style.
Input image: Image 1 is the inspected 2×2 neutral source grid for NPC 082. Use it as exact identity, palette, pixel-grid, eye-contour and aperture reference.
Primary request: Create one exact 2×2 atlas, 1024×560 pixels total, with each cell at 64:35 aspect and enlarged consistently. Row-major cells: top-left image-left gaze, open eyes; top-right image-right gaze, open eyes; bottom-left image-left gaze, half blink; bottom-right image-right gaze, half blink.
Subject and consistency: same NPC 082 face in all cells. Preserve exact original upper/lower lid contours, eye aperture, iris size, neutral brows through their source band, eye spacing, face framing, hair, background, muted palette, and all anatomy outside the eye regions. Change gaze only by a gentle approximately one-native-pixel horizontal shift of each iris/pupil. Both eyes look in the named image direction together. Keep the source's own iris color, muted beige sclera, tiny mild glints, and native pixel clusters. Do not widen either eye opening. Half-blink cells retain original lid contours and aperture shape while showing restrained upper-lid coverage.
Constraints: Exact 2×2 layout and 64:35 cell aspect. Native hard pixel edges, no antialiasing or blur. No vertical or diagonal gaze, no extra phases, no enlarged irises, no broad white bands, no new colors, no facial or brow changes, no labels, borders, gutters, text, or watermark.
